I would group your Sikkim memories into a quiet journey about patience and light. 

I’d use **"The three of us under Kanchenjunga"** because it captures the central moment you waited three days for. 
I’d pair it with **"Cloud coming up the valley"** for that vast, cold stillness. 
And I’d end with **"The last morning"** to close the trip, right "before the drive back down." 

Shall we weave these together?
